# Leaving the settings search box with the keyboard (fix/keys111). Compare each shot with the same script on main.
# - keys111-done: Shift+Tab from nothing puts the white focus ring on Done (the same on both).
# - keys111-search-enter: "glow" typed in the search box, then Enter. On the branch the ring is on the FIRST result
#   (the top row of the list, under its first card title). On main it went from Done round to the Lyrics switch at
#   the bottom of the sidebar, so the list has no ring at all.
# - keys111-search-tab: Down twice from there, the search box used again, then Tab. On the branch the ring is back on
#   the first result. On main it is on the second result (main's Down twice went from the Lyrics switch over Preview to
#   the first result, and Tab carried on to the one after it).
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/keys111 -f script=.github/checks/keys111.txt

cmd time set noon
cmd weather clear
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 3
gui 1
sleep 2
key tab shift
sleep 1
shot keys111-done
search glow
sleep 1
key enter
sleep 1
shot keys111-search-enter
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
search glow
sleep 1
key tab
sleep 1
shot keys111-search-tab
close
guiscale 0
